updates.old: Daytona is an open-source cloud development environment (CDE) platform — self-hostable alternative to Gitpod / GitHub Codespaces. 2024 added AI-agent sandbox tier for ephemeral agent code execution. Apache 2.0. Founded by ex-Atlas Antillia / Codeanywhere team (Ivan Burazin). $5M seed 2024 (RTP Global + others). Distinct from e2b / Modal by being self-hostable-first.
updates.new: Daytona is secure, elastic sandbox infrastructure for running AI-generated code and agent workflows (isolated sandboxes with snapshots, volumes, computer use, MCP server). Pivoted from an open-source cloud development environment; as of June 2026 core development moved to a private codebase and the daytonaio/daytona repo was archived (2026-10-03). SDKs, API clients and CLI/MCP tools are published in the open daytona/clients repo. Founded by the ex-Codeanywhere team (Ivan Burazin).
Apache-2.0 (SDKs in daytona/clients; CLI under AGPL-3.0); core platform closed-source since June 2026 (archived OSS repo remains under its original license at v0.190.0)
